display.purpose: Uppercase latin broadcast titles — topbar brand, facility console title. Saira Condensed.

heading-ko.purpose: Korean facility names and section headings at heavy weight. Noto Sans KR 800/900.

data.purpose: All numbers quoted from the twin — timers, patch-count LED, stat values, scores. JetBrains Mono.

body.purpose: Base UI text, team names, log prose. Noto Sans KR 400.

label.purpose: Field keys, overlay headers, enum badges, column headers. JetBrains Mono uppercase, wide tracking, sub color.

shadows.name: active-node-ring
shadows.purpose: Zero-blur solid red ring around the active arena target node. The only box-shadow in the system; a HUD accent, not elevation — flat by doctrine, no ambient or cast shadow.

motion.name: reduced-motion-kill
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion all animation and transition are disabled globally.

effects.name: overlay-backdrop-blur
effects.purpose: Legibility backdrop under floating arena HUD overlays (.ov) so the dome reads through faintly. A HUD readability device, not a glow — recorded, not a decorative effect.

components.name: Execute Button
components.description: Primary attack-execute action in the facility console exploit bar.
components.css: .ds-btn-exec { font-family: 'Saira Condensed', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; background: var(--lf-red2, #e23b43); border: 1px solid #ff7a7e; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-exec:hover { background: var(--lf-red, #ff5b60); } .ds-btn-exec:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lf-cyan, #54b8ec); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-exec:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Back / Breadcrumb Button
components.description: Ghost control returning from a facility console to the arena.
components.css: .ds-btn-back { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--lf-mut, #8aa3c2); background: none; border: none; padding: 0 16px; height: 100%; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-back:hover { color: var(--lf-cyan, #54b8ec); } .ds-btn-back:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lf-cyan, #54b8ec); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Bracket-HUD Panel
components.description: Flat content panel with tick-cyan L-shaped corner brackets; the console's primary container.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; background: var(--lf-panel, #0d1a2c); border: 1px solid var(--lf-line, #21374f); border-radius: 0; } .ds-panel::before, .ds-panel::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1.5px solid var(--lf-tick, #4fb3e6); opacity: 0.7; } .ds-panel::before { left: -1px; top: -1px; border-right: none; border-bottom: none; } .ds-panel::after { right: -1px; bottom: -1px; border-left: none; border-top: none; } .ds-panel-head { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--lf-sub, #5f7b9e); padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--lf-panel2, #0f1f34); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lf-line, #21374f); }

components.name: Service Status Enum Badge
components.description: Tiny mono status badge for service-state (up / compromised / down) and solve-log tags.
components.html: UP COMPROMISED DOWN
components.css: .ds-enum { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-enum-up { background: #0d2a1e; color: var(--lf-green, #49c88a); } .ds-enum-compromised { background: #2a1013; color: var(--lf-red, #ff5b60); } .ds-enum-down { background: #2a2410; color: var(--lf-amber, #f2b84b); }

components.name: Kill-Chain Chevron
components.description: Rightward-pointing phase cell in the kill-chain strip; done=blue, active=red fill.
components.css: .ds-chevron { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 14px 6px 22px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--lf-dim, #45607e); clip-path: polygon(14px 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 14px 100%, 0 50%); } .ds-chevron .n { font-size: 9px; color: #38506b; } .ds-chevron .pts { margin-left: auto; font-size: 9px; } .ds-chevron-done { color: var(--lf-blue, #3f7fd6); background: #0b1f30; } .ds-chevron-active { color: #fff; background: var(--lf-red2, #e23b43); } .ds-chevron-active .n { color: #ffd0d1; }

components.name: Arena Facility Node
components.description: Percent-positioned status node in the radial dome constellation; status is fill color and ring thickness only.
components.css: .ds-node { position: relative; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; width: 92px; color: inherit; padding: 0; } .ds-node .sq { display: block; width: 11px; height: 11px; margin: 0 auto; background: var(--lf-orange, #ff7a44); } .ds-node .lb { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 8.5px; color: #c7d6ea; margin-top: 4px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-node .lb .id { color: var(--lf-mut, #8aa3c2); font-size: 8px; } .ds-node-active .sq { width: 15px; height: 15px; background: var(--lf-red, #ff5b60); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #ff556033; } .ds-node .ring, .ds-node .ring2 { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 7px; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-node-active .ring { width: 46px; height: 46px; border: 1.5px solid #ff5560aa; } .ds-node-active .ring2 { width: 78px; height: 78px; border: 1px solid #ff556055; } .ds-node:hover .sq { outline: 1px solid #ffffff55; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Live Register Row
components.description: A row of the facility twin register table — name · addr · value · state, value toned by severity.
components.html:
SAFETY_INTERLOCK coil0
OFF
BYPASS
components.css: .ds-reg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 78px 62px; align-items: center; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10.5px; border-bottom: 1px solid #132639; } .ds-reg > div { padding: 5px 9px; } .ds-reg .rn { color: var(--lf-mut, #8aa3c2); } .ds-reg .ra { color: var(--lf-sub, #5f7b9e); font-size: 9px; } .ds-reg .rv { text-align: right; font-weight: 700; } .ds-reg .rv.red { color: var(--lf-red, #ff5b60); } .ds-reg .rv.amber { color: var(--lf-amber, #f2b84b); } .ds-reg .rv.blue { color: var(--lf-blue, #3f7fd6); } .ds-reg .rs { text-align: center; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-reg .rs.al { color: var(--lf-red, #ff5b60); } .ds-reg .rs.ok { color: var(--lf-green, #49c88a); }

narrative.overview: A national live-fire cyber-range operations console built to be read like a televised CCE / Locked Shields broadcast board, not a CTF flag-submission form. It opens on a radial dome status arena — the whole country's critical-infrastructure under live fire as a constellation of facility nodes fanning up from a single apex — and drills into a flat, dense, per-facility operator console (OT intrusion map, physical-twin schematic, live register table, service-status board, kill-chain chevrons). Everything on screen is grounded in real twin code: asset names, protocols, ports, registers, vulnerability IDs and scores are quoted, never invented. The world sits on the platform's shared dark tokens but overlays its own CCE-broadcast language: a deep navy space field, a strict red↔blue duality (red = attack / Red-team / live danger; cyan and blue = defense / systems / telemetry), hairline-bordered flat panels, bracket-HUD corner ticks, and operator-display typography. The finished build removed the bottom radial bloom/vignette an earlier pass carried — surfaces are flat, lit only by tonal layering and hairline borders.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-navy broadcast space with a radial dome-and-constellation signature.
Red↔blue duality as the core semantic axis; status is color, fill, ring-thickness, never glow.
Flat hairline panels with bracket-HUD corner ticks; zero corner radius.
Tri-font HUD stack: Saira Condensed (latin display), Noto Sans KR (korean headings), JetBrains Mono (all data).
Drawn single-stroke SVG icons only; no emoji, no icon fonts.

rules.name: The Red↔Blue Duality Rule
rules.body: Red always means attacker / live danger; cyan and blue always mean defense / system / telemetry. Never color a defensive readout red or an attack readout blue — the two poles carry the whole broadcast's meaning.

rules.name: The Status-Is-Not-Glow Rule
rules.body: Node and register status is expressed through fill color, ring thickness, and label color only. The single box-shadow on the active node is a zero-blur solid ring (0 0 0 5px), not a halo. No bloom, no glow, no vignette.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Truth Rule
rules.body: Any value quoted from the twin — register, port, protocol, score, timer, vuln ID, timestamp — is set in JetBrains Mono. Prose and names are sans; data is mono. The mono face is the signal that this is real telemetry, not copy.

rules.name: The Flat-Panel Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. Elevation is one tonal step up plus a hairline border; if a surface needs to feel active it changes its border color or fill ground, never its shadow.

dos: Do keep the red↔blue duality absolute: red = attack/live, cyan+blue = defense/system.
Do set every twin-sourced value (register, port, score, timer, vuln ID) in JetBrains Mono.
Do express status through fill, ring thickness, and label color; keep panels flat with a hairline border and one tonal step.
Do use the bracket-HUD corner tick, kill-chain chevron, and hexagon brand as the only non-rectangular silhouettes.
Do draw icons as single-stroke 24×24 SVG with currentColor.
donts: Don't add glow, bloom, vignette, grain, or scanlines — the finish removed the radial bloom on purpose.
Don't round corners; the only radius in the system is the 6px scrollbar thumb.
Don't use emoji or icon fonts for iconography.
Don't ship a CTF flag-submission panel, a generic SOC panel-grid, or neon cyberpunk treatment.
Don't reach for a system display face; latin display is Saira Condensed, korean is Noto Sans KR, data is JetBrains Mono.
